description: Download a file from OneDrive in chunks using HTTP Range requests. Use for files 10 MB or larger. Call repeatedly with increasing offset values until has_more is false. Returns content_base64, content_type, offset, chunk_size, total_size, and has_more.

chunk_size.description: Bytes to read per call. Defaults to 5 MB, max 10 MB.

offset.description: Byte offset to start reading from. Defaults to 0.

name: download_file_stream
